Method of Attack: Unauthenticated Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability allowing injection of malicious JavaScript scripts
Creation of rogue admin accounts on WordPress websites
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites running Beautiful Cookie Consent Banner plugin
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unauthenticated stored XSS vulnerability in the plugin
Indicators of Compromise: Nearly 3 million attacks blocked against more than 1.5 million sites from nearly 14,000 IP addresses since May 23, 2023
Corruption of plugin's configuration stored in nsc_bar_bannersettings_json option
